question: How many customers are there?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Customer

question: How many tracks are in the database?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Track

question: How many employees does the company have?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Employee

question: List the names of all media types.
gold_sql: SELECT Name FROM MediaType

question: How many customers are from the USA?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Customer WHERE Country = 'USA'

question: What is the highest unit price of any track?
gold_sql: SELECT MAX(UnitPrice) FROM Track

question: What is the average invoice total, rounded to 2 decimals?
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(Total), 2) FROM Invoice

question: How many genres are there?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Genre

question: Which cities in Canada do customers live in?
gold_sql: SELECT DISTINCT City FROM Customer WHERE Country = 'Canada'

question: How many invoices have a billing country of Germany?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Invoice WHERE BillingCountry = 'Germany'

question: What is the name of the longest track by duration?
gold_sql: SELECT Name FROM Track ORDER BY Milliseconds DESC LIMIT 1

question: How many playlists are there?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Playlist

question: What are the first and last names of employees with the title 'Sales Support Agent'?
gold_sql: SELECT FirstName, LastName FROM Employee WHERE Title = 'Sales Support Agent'

question: How many tracks have a unit price of 1.99?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Track WHERE UnitPrice = 1.99

question: How many albums does AC/DC have?
gold_sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Album al JOIN Artist ar ON ar.ArtistId = al.ArtistId
WHERE ar.Name = 'AC/DC'

question: List the titles of albums by Aerosmith.
gold_sql:
SELECT al.Title FROM Album al JOIN Artist ar ON ar.ArtistId = al.ArtistId
WHERE ar.Name = 'Aerosmith'

question: How many tracks are in the Jazz genre?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Track t JOIN Genre g ON g.GenreId = t.GenreId WHERE g.Name = 'Jazz'

question: What is the total amount invoiced to customers who live in Brazil?
gold_sql:
SELECT ROUND(SUM(i.Total), 2) FROM Invoice i
JOIN Customer c ON c.CustomerId = i.CustomerId WHERE c.Country = 'Brazil'

question: Which artist has the most tracks?
gold_sql:
SELECT ar.Name FROM Artist ar
JOIN Album al ON al.ArtistId = ar.ArtistId JOIN Track t ON t.AlbumId = al.AlbumId
GROUP BY ar.ArtistId ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1

question: What are the first and last names of the customer who has spent the most money?
gold_sql:
SELECT c.FirstName, c.LastName FROM Customer c
JOIN Invoice i ON i.CustomerId = c.CustomerId
GROUP BY c.CustomerId ORDER BY SUM(i.Total) DESC LIMIT 1

question: How many tracks are there for each media type? Show the media type name and count.
gold_sql:
SELECT mt.Name, COUNT(*) FROM Track t
JOIN MediaType mt ON mt.MediaTypeId = t.MediaTypeId GROUP BY mt.MediaTypeId

question: How many tracks are on the playlist named 'Grunge'?
gold_sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM PlaylistTrack pt
JOIN Playlist p ON p.PlaylistId = pt.PlaylistId WHERE p.Name = 'Grunge'

question: Which media type has the most tracks?
gold_sql:
SELECT mt.Name FROM Track t JOIN MediaType mt ON mt.MediaTypeId = t.MediaTypeId
GROUP BY mt.MediaTypeId ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1

question: List the names of the tracks on the album 'Let There Be Rock'.
gold_sql:
SELECT t.Name FROM Track t JOIN Album al ON al.AlbumId = t.AlbumId
WHERE al.Title = 'Let There Be Rock'
expected_rows: Hell Ain't A Bad Place To Be

question: What genre is the track 'Balls to the Wall'?
gold_sql:
SELECT g.Name FROM Track t JOIN Genre g ON g.GenreId = t.GenreId
WHERE t.Name = 'Balls to the Wall'

question: How many invoices does the customer with email 'luisg@embraer.com.br' have?
gold_sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Invoice i JOIN Customer c ON c.CustomerId = i.CustomerId
WHERE c.Email = 'luisg@embraer.com.br'

question: What are the first and last names of the person Jane Peacock reports to?
gold_sql:
SELECT m.FirstName, m.LastName FROM Employee e JOIN Employee m ON m.EmployeeId = e.ReportsTo
WHERE e.FirstName = 'Jane' AND e.LastName = 'Peacock'

question: What are the names of the top 5 genres by total sales amount (unit price times quantity)?
gold_sql:
SELECT g.Name FROM InvoiceLine il
JOIN Track t ON t.TrackId = il.TrackId JOIN Genre g ON g.GenreId = t.GenreId
GROUP BY g.GenreId ORDER BY SUM(il.UnitPrice * il.Quantity) DESC LIMIT 5

question: Which year had the highest total invoice revenue?
gold_sql:
SELECT strftime('%Y', InvoiceDate) FROM Invoice
GROUP BY strftime('%Y', InvoiceDate) ORDER BY SUM(Total) DESC LIMIT 1

question: What is the average number of tracks per album, rounded to 2 decimals?
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(n), 2) FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM Track GROUP BY AlbumId)

question: How many customers made at least one purchase in both 2009 and 2013?
gold_sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (
  SELECT CustomerId FROM Invoice WHERE strftime('%Y', InvoiceDate) = '2009'
  INTERSECT
  SELECT CustomerId FROM Invoice WHERE strftime('%Y', InvoiceDate) = '2013')

question: Which month of 2011 had the highest invoice revenue? Give the month as a number.
gold_sql:
SELECT CAST(strftime('%m', InvoiceDate) AS INTEGER) FROM Invoice
WHERE strftime('%Y', InvoiceDate) = '2011'
GROUP BY strftime('%m', InvoiceDate) ORDER BY SUM(Total) DESC LIMIT 1

question: For each year, how many distinct customers made a purchase?
gold_sql:
SELECT strftime('%Y', InvoiceDate), COUNT(DISTINCT CustomerId) FROM Invoice
GROUP BY strftime('%Y', InvoiceDate)

question: Which support rep's customers generated the most invoice revenue in 2012? Give the rep's first and last name.
gold_sql:
SELECT e.FirstName, e.LastName FROM Employee e
JOIN Customer c ON c.SupportRepId = e.EmployeeId
JOIN Invoice i ON i.CustomerId = c.CustomerId
WHERE strftime('%Y', i.InvoiceDate) = '2012'
GROUP BY e.EmployeeId ORDER BY SUM(i.Total) DESC LIMIT 1

question: What percentage of all tracks belong to the Rock genre, rounded to 2 decimals?
gold_sql:
SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN g.Name = 'Rock' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2)
FROM Track t JOIN Genre g ON g.GenreId = t.GenreId

question: Among artists with at least 10 tracks, which artist has the highest average track length in milliseconds?
gold_sql:
SELECT ar.Name FROM Artist ar
JOIN Album al ON al.ArtistId = ar.ArtistId JOIN Track t ON t.AlbumId = al.AlbumId
GROUP BY ar.ArtistId HAVING COUNT(*) >= 10 ORDER BY AVG(t.Milliseconds) DESC LIMIT 1

question: How much higher was total invoice revenue in 2013 than in 2009, rounded to 2 decimals?
gold_sql:
SELECT ROUND(
  SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%Y', InvoiceDate) = '2013' THEN Total ELSE 0 END)
  - SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%Y', InvoiceDate) = '2009' THEN Total ELSE 0 END), 2)
FROM Invoice

question: How many invoices have a total greater than the average invoice total?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Invoice WHERE Total > (SELECT AVG(Total) FROM Invoice)

question: Which countries have more than 4 customers?
gold_sql: SELECT Country FROM Customer GROUP BY Country HAVING COUNT(*) > 4

question: Which customers (first and last name) have spent more than 45 in total across all their invoices?
gold_sql:
SELECT c.FirstName, c.LastName FROM Customer c
JOIN Invoice i ON i.CustomerId = c.CustomerId
GROUP BY c.CustomerId HAVING SUM(i.Total) > 45
